summary: On RHEL, create cron-gather and cron-report scripts that export METRICS_UTILITY_SHIP_TARGET=directory and METRICS_UTILITY_SHIP_PATH, then run `metrics-utility gather_automation_controller_billing_data --ship --until=10m` and `metrics-utility build_report`.
questions: How do I write a cron script for metrics-utility gather?
How do I build a metrics-utility report on RHEL?

answer_card.title: metrics-utility gather and report scripts
answer_card.answer_md:
```sh
# /home/my-user/cron-gather
export METRICS_UTILITY_SHIP_TARGET=directory
export METRICS_UTILITY_SHIP_PATH=/path/to/shipped_data/billing
metrics-utility gather_automation_controller_billing_data --ship --until=10m

# /home/my-user/cron-report (same exports)
metrics-utility build_report
```
Make both executable and schedule them with cron.
